transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net landline customer services, my name is Simon. How can I help you today?

transcript.text: Yes, it is 72 Kingsway, Dundee, DD2 3PT, and my security PIN is 6309. My landline telephone handset is a BT 8600 Call Guardian unit.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: They show up with random UK mobile numbers and local area codes, and when you pick up it is an automated voice pretending to be HMRC or bank fraud departments because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I check your line routing and digital call features on our exchange switch in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.text: My ninety-one-year-old mother lives with me and suffers from dementia! She gets terrified every time the phone rings, thinking someone is coming to arrest her! Why don't you block these criminals at the network exchange because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.text: These are not legitimate marketing companies, Simon, they are criminal fraudsters! The TPS does not stop illegal spoofed scam calls since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.text: You need to purchase an external call blocker hardware box from Amazon or visit our online shop to buy our premium call guardian service to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.text: Sales queues are currently busy with a forty-five minute hold queue. You should activate call features via your online account portal to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.
